title: Valet Savings Amount for a Stay under Ashbury Rewards: Guest Folios Accounting Note
content:
**Amount.** The Ashbury Rewards valet savings of a stay on Guest Folios are the nightly valet saving times the number of valet lines of the stay, rounded half up to the cent at the end. The nightly valet saving is the member valet saving percent of 4% of the brand's valet rate.

The brand's valet rate is the brand's valet figure per night parked in the brand parking schedule, and the number of valet lines is every valet parking line posted on the folio of the stay.

## Condition, figure, result

| Input | Hypothetical value | Figure |
|---|---|---|
| Brand's valet rate | $50.00 | — |
| Nightly valet saving | 4% of $50.00 | $2.00 |
| Valet lines on the folio | 3 | — |
| Valet savings of the stay | $2.00 times 3 | **$6.00** |

A second hypothetical stay: a valet rate of $47.50 and five valet lines. The nightly valet saving is 4% of $47.50, $1.90; times 5, the valet savings are **$9.50**.

A third: a valet rate of $63.30 and three valet lines. 4% of $63.30 is $2.532 a night; times 3 that is $7.596, rounded half up to the cent once at the end: **$7.60**. The nightly figure is not rounded on its own.
